source_text: Me? What do you need me for?

Now, if I get proof, the people of Junktown will kick him out.
# Way I figure it, you need to either plant a bug at his place or wear a wire
# and get him to confess to you. Can you handle that?

text: 如果我有证据，迦克镇的人就会把他赶出城去。我的办法是，你把窃听器安在他办公室或者用录音机录下他的自供，你能搞定吗？
source_text: 如果我有证据，迦克镇的人就会把他赶出城去。我的办法是，你把窃听器安在他办公室或者用录音机录下他的自供，你能搞定吗？

text: Whoa. Sounds kinda dangerous . . .
source_text: Whoa. Sounds kinda dangerous . . .

text: 哦，看起来有点危险呐……
source_text: 哦，看起来有点危险呐……

text: What do I get in return?
source_text: What do I get in return?

text: 我能得到什么？
source_text: 我能得到什么？

text: Ummm . . . no. Getting involved in other people's# problems never works out.
source_text:
Ummm . . . no. Getting involved in other people's
# problems never works out.

text: 嗯……算了。掺和到别人的恩怨是非里面去是不妥当的。
source_text: 嗯……算了。掺和到别人的恩怨是非里面去是不妥当的。

I'm not gonna lie to you, it will be dangerous. But I'll owe you

text: 我不想骗你，这的确是有点危险。但我会记住你的这份人情，我，基利安·达克沃特，一定会还你这份人情的。

text: You sure you can't find someone else?
source_text: You sure you can't find someone else?

text: 你真找不到其他人来办这个事情了？
source_text: 你真找不到其他人来办这个事情了？

text: What do you mean, 'pays his debts.'
source_text: What do you mean, 'pays his debts.'

text: 什么叫做“还我人情”？
source_text: 什么叫做“还我人情”？

text: I don't think so. Sounds too dangerous to me.
source_text: I don't think so. Sounds too dangerous to me.

text: 我不干，太危险了。
source_text: 我不干，太危险了。

text: It'll work best if it's you. Gizmo doesn't know you, so he might trust# you. Or, at least he'll have a hard time blaming me. Either way, you're the best# person for the job.
source_text:
It'll work best if it's you. Gizmo doesn't know you, so he might trust
# you. Or, at least he'll have a hard time blaming me. Either way, you're the best
# person for the job.

text: 你是最适合的人选。吉斯莫不认识你，所以很可能会相信你。至少他不会怀疑到我。怎么说，你都是最好的人选。
source_text: 你是最适合的人选。吉斯莫不认识你，所以很可能会相信你。至少他不会怀疑到我。怎么说，你都是最好的人选。

text: Fair enough, I'll do it.
source_text: Fair enough, I'll do it.

text: 好，我去。
source_text: 好，我去。

text: Pass. Getting killed doesn't seem like a fun thing for me.
source_text: Pass. Getting killed doesn't seem like a fun thing for me.

text: 算了。把小命丢了可不是闹着玩的。
source_text: 算了。把小命丢了可不是闹着玩的。

source_text: What do I get out of this?

source_text: 我有什么好处？

text: I'll tell you what. Anything in the store, even the most expensive,# it's yours. No charge. If it's a gun, I'll give you all the ammo you can carry.# Does that sound fair?
source_text:
I'll tell you what. Anything in the store, even the most expensive,
# it's yours. No charge. If it's a gun, I'll give you all the ammo you can carry.
# Does that sound fair?

text: 那我跟你讲清楚吧。这个店里的所有东西，即使是最贵的，都是你的了。免费！如果你要枪，我会给你多到你那不下，这个交易划得来吧？
source_text: 那我跟你讲清楚吧。这个店里的所有东西，即使是最贵的，都是你的了。免费！如果你要枪，我会给你多到你那不下，这个交易划得来吧？

text: Yeah. I'll do it.
source_text: Yeah. I'll do it.

text: 好，我干了！
source_text: 好，我干了！

text: Not even close. I'm not risking my neck for that.
source_text: Not even close. I'm not risking my neck for that.

text: 还是不想。我不会为这个玩命的。
source_text: 还是不想。我不会为这个玩命的。

source_text:
Well, damn. That's too bad. But, you know, I'm gonna have to lock
# you up until this thing's done. Can't risk Gizmo finding out. Sorry.

source_text: 可恶。真是抱歉，在我自己搞定这件事之前，我要把你关起来，免得你可能会去为吉斯莫通风报信，失礼了。

text: All right, I owe you. Here's the bug and the wire tap.# You let me know when it's done. And good luck.
source_text:
All right, I owe you. Here's the bug and the wire tap.
# You let me know when it's done. And good luck.

text: 太好了，我会报答你的。给你窃听器和录音机，搞定后向我回话，祝你好运！
source_text: 太好了，我会报答你的。给你窃听器和录音机，搞定后向我回话，祝你好运！

text: 你拿到证据了？
source_text: 你拿到证据了？

text: Not yet. But I will, believe me!
source_text: Not yet. But I will, believe me!

text: 还没，我会的，相信我！
source_text: 还没，我会的，相信我！

text: I sure did.
source_text: I sure did.

text: 当然了。
source_text: 当然了。

source_text:
Well, he's not going to come here and confess! You shouldn't even be
# seen with me until this is done. Now go.

source_text: 他不会到我这里来自首吧！拿到证据之前，你不要到我这里来乱晃，免得他起疑，赶紧去办事。

source_text: Which, bug or tape?

text: 窃听器还是录音带？
source_text: 窃听器还是录音带？

text: The bug.
source_text: The bug.

source_text: 窃听器。

source_text: The confession.

source_text: 他的自供词。

Loud and clear. We're going to get him. In the mean time, we've

source_text: 这是很充足的证据！我们现在就去抓他。对了，我还要和你谈个事情……

text: Let's hear it.
source_text: Let's hear it.

text: 好，听一下。
source_text: 好，听一下。

text: That's the first time I've been happy to hear his voice. Thanks,# friend.  Now, time for you and me to take care of the other business.
source_text:
That's the first time I've been happy to hear his voice. Thanks,
# friend.  Now, time for you and me to take care of the other business.

text: 多年来，这还是第一次我听到这个猪头的声音后没起鸡皮疙瘩，多谢啦，朋友。我还有件事情要和你商量。先说你的报酬吧。
source_text: 多年来，这还是第一次我听到这个猪头的声音后没起鸡皮疙瘩，多谢啦，朋友。我还有件事情要和你商量。先说你的报酬吧。

text: Well, thanks again. Oh, listen, I'm gonna take the guards and run# Gizmo and his cronies out of town. I could use another gun. You up for it?# Might be good for a laugh.
source_text:
Well, thanks again. Oh, listen, I'm gonna take the guards and run
# Gizmo and his cronies out of town. I could use another gun. You up for it?
# Might be good for a laugh.

text: 我再次谢谢你。还有呢，我要带些守卫去废了吉斯莫和他的跟班，我们的人越多越好，你想不想来，看看好戏去？
source_text: 我再次谢谢你。还有呢，我要带些守卫去废了吉斯莫和他的跟班，我们的人越多越好，你想不想来，看看好戏去？

text: Sure. It'll be worth it just to see him try to walk more than ten feet.
source_text: Sure. It'll be worth it just to see him try to walk more than ten feet.

text: 当然了，看他最后的蹦达还是很有趣的。
source_text: 当然了，看他最后的蹦达还是很有趣的。

text: Kinda depends on what you're willing to give me.
source_text: Kinda depends on what you're willing to give me.

text: 这次你有什么好处给我？
source_text: 这次你有什么好处给我？

text: Again? I don't think so. I've got way too much stuff going on.
source_text: Again? I don't think so. I've got way too much stuff going on.

Go to Lars at the guard station. He'll fill you in.

source_text: 跟守卫站的拉尔斯说，他会给你安排。对了，我要说，我们镇子都很感激你……非常感谢。

Well, I can pay you the standard rate for mercenary work,

text: Done.

text: 成交！

source_text: 很好，找拉尔斯去，他会和你细谈。

Listen, that's all I'm offering. Thanks for getting the

source_text: 听着，这是我的最高价码了。我很感谢你帮我取得证据，但我也不是事事都要靠你的。

text: All right, I'll do it for that fee.

text: 那好吧，就这个价了。
source_text: 那好吧，就这个价了。

text: Oh, well. See ya around.
source_text: Oh, well. See ya around.

text: 哦，那好，回见了。
source_text: 哦，那好，回见了。

text: Good luck in your travels. Now if you'll excuse me, I have a fat ass# to move.
source_text:
Good luck in your travels. Now if you'll excuse me, I have a fat ass
# to move.

source_text: 旅途愉快，抱歉，让个道，我要办事去了。

text: Gizmo owns the casino. Named it after himself.# Be very careful around him.

Gizmo owns the casino. Named it after himself.
# Be very careful around him.

text: 吉斯莫开了个赌场，就叫吉斯莫赌场。你要小心这个人。
source_text: 吉斯莫开了个赌场，就叫吉斯莫赌场。你要小心这个人。

text: Well, that's me. Where have you been?

text: 那就是我啊。你走神了？
source_text: 那就是我啊。你走神了？

text: Oh, Lars heads up the guards here. He's a good guy.# Pretty trustworthy.
source_text:
Oh, Lars heads up the guards here. He's a good guy.
# Pretty trustworthy.

text: 哦，拉尔斯是守卫的头儿，是个好人，很值得信任。
source_text: 哦，拉尔斯是守卫的头儿，是个好人，很值得信任。

text: Well Vinnie, he's one of the problem children. He leads a group# of punks called the Skulz. Still, they pay rent, and they haven't bothered# anyone too much.
source_text:
Well Vinnie, he's one of the problem children. He leads a group
# of punks called the Skulz. Still, they pay rent, and they haven't bothered
# anyone too much.

text: Well, Doc owns a little place in the middle of the town. Does# a nice patch job if you need it. Fairly reasonable prices.
source_text:
Well, Doc owns a little place in the middle of the town. Does
# a nice patch job if you need it. Fairly reasonable prices.

text: 医生在镇中央有个小诊所，手术做得不赖，价格还算公道。
source_text: 医生在镇中央有个小诊所，手术做得不赖，价格还算公道。

source_text:
The Skulz are a bunch of punks who work for Gizmo. They don't cause
# that much trouble, but me and Lars keep an eye on them.

text: 骷髅党是为吉斯莫跑腿的一帮混混，他们没惹出太大的事情，但是我和拉尔斯一直盯着他们。
